note: Free courses in Bahasa Malaysia and other languages, shown beside a pathway step as another way to learn the same skill. They never replace the step's course, so plans, hours and rankings are unchanged. Titles, durations and the number of languages are as listed on Rakyat Digital's Literacy Hub (Ministry of Digital, run by MyDIGITAL Corporation), checked on the date given; the four languages are those named when the Ministry launched AI Untuk Rakyat (Bahasa Malaysia, English, Chinese and Tamil).
